question: What's the longest a Temporary Access Pass can be valid for?
answer: A TAP's lifetime can be configured between 10 minutes and 43,200 minutes (30 days). The policy's default maximum lifetime is 8 hours.
evidence: 10 – 43,200 Minutes (30 days)

question: How many wrong password attempts does it take before smart lockout locks an account in a normal commercial tenant?
answer: 10 failed attempts (the default lockout threshold in Azure Public and 21Vianet tenants).
evidence: 10 failed attempts in Azure Public
The default is 10 for Azure Public tenants

question: A user got locked out by smart lockout. If they reset their password with 'I forgot my password', do they still have to wait for the lockout to run out?
answer: No. Choosing 'I forgot my password' in SSPR resets the lockout duration to 0 seconds. With 'I know my password' the lockout timer keeps running.
evidence: the duration of the lockout is reset to 0 seconds

question: Do passwords of users synced with password hash sync expire in Entra ID?
answer: Not by default: for password hash synchronized users the Entra ID password expiration is set to never expire, so they can still sign in to Entra ID with an expired on-premises password unless the cloud password policy is enforced for synced users.
evidence: the Microsoft Entra ID password expiration is set to never expire

question: Which password reset policy applies to admin accounts, and can admins use security questions to reset?
answer: Administrators get a strong default two-gate policy that requires two pieces of authentication data (e.g. email, authenticator app, phone). It prohibits security questions and can't be changed.
evidence: The two-gate policy requires two pieces of authentication data

question: We disabled self-service password reset for administrators. How long before that change applies?
answer: Up to 60 minutes (the change is made by setting AllowedToUseSspr to false on the tenant authorization policy).
evidence: can take up to 60 minutes to take effect

question: By default, how often are users asked to sign in again?
answer: The default sign-in frequency is a rolling window of 90 days.
evidence: rolling window of 90 days

question: Why does Microsoft recommend blocking legacy authentication protocols?
answer: Legacy protocols don't support MFA; more than 97% of credential stuffing attacks and more than 99% of password spray attacks use legacy authentication.
evidence: more than 99 percent of password spray attacks

question: Is there a way to see what a Conditional Access policy would do before turning it on?
answer: Yes, report-only mode: policies are evaluated at sign-in but not enforced, so admins can assess impact. It doesn't work for policies scoped to User Actions.
evidence: Report-only mode is a policy state that lets administrators test

question: How many words can we put on our custom banned password list?
answer: A maximum of 1,000 terms.
evidence: limited to a maximum of 1,000 terms

question: Can we switch off Microsoft's global banned password list?
answer: No. The global banned password list is enabled for all tenants and can't be disabled.
evidence: The global banned password list is enabled for all tenants

question: How long can a custom security question for password reset be?
answer: 200 characters at most.
evidence: maximum length of a custom security question is 200 characters

question: When will security questions stop working for self-service password reset?
answer: They are being retired for SSPR in March 2027.
evidence: in March 2027

question: I revoked a user's sessions. How long can the access token they already have keep working?
answer: Access tokens issued by Entra ID last 1 hour by default, so an existing access token can stay valid until it expires (unless the app supports continuous access evaluation).
evidence: access tokens issued by Microsoft Entra ID last for 1 hour

question: How many custom domain names can one tenant have?
answer: Up to 5,000 managed domain names; if all domains are federated with on-premises AD, up to 2,500 per organization.
evidence: You can add up to 5000 managed domain names

question: Is there a limit to how many dynamic membership groups a tenant can have?
answer: Yes, a maximum of 15,000 dynamic membership groups per tenant.
evidence: maximum of 15,000 dynamic membership groups

question: I changed the rule of a dynamic group but its members haven't updated. How long can that take?
answer: Depending on the size of the organization, populating can take up to 24 hours the first time or after a rule change.
evidence: up to 24 hours for populating

question: How many groups can a memberOf dynamic group rule reference?
answer: Up to 50 member groups per dynamic group.
evidence: Each dynamic group can have up to 50 member groups

question: We restricted what guest users can see in the directory. When does that take effect?
answer: It can take up to 15 minutes to take effect for guest users.
evidence: up to 15 minutes to take effect for guest users

question: What counts as an inactive guest in the inactive guest report?
answer: Guests with 90 days of inactivity.
evidence: based on 90 days of inactivity

question: How far back can I see Conditional Access policy changes in the audit log?
answer: Audit log data is kept for 30 days by default; send it to Log Analytics (Azure Monitor) to keep it longer.
evidence: Audit log data is kept for 30 days by default

question: If a Conditional Access policy has several grant controls ticked, does the user have to satisfy all of them?
answer: By default yes, all selected controls are required; the policy can instead be set to require one of the selected controls.
evidence: By default, Conditional Access requires all selected controls

question: Does number matching work for Authenticator push notifications on an Apple Watch?
answer: No, number matching isn't supported for push notifications on Apple Watch or Android wearable devices.
evidence: Number matching isn't supported for push notifications for Apple Watch

question: What kind of hardware OATH tokens does Entra ID support?
answer: OATH TOTP SHA-1 tokens that refresh codes every 30 or 60 seconds; secret keys are limited to 128 characters.
evidence: OATH TOTP SHA-1 tokens that refresh codes every 30 or 60 seconds

question: Can B2B guest users sign in with SMS as their first factor?
answer: No, SMS-based authentication isn't supported for B2B accounts.
evidence: SMS-based authentication isn't supported for B2B accounts

question: How many people can use Windows Hello for Business on the same PC?
answer: Up to 10 users per device; it shouldn't be used on kiosk devices with a shared account.
evidence: Windows Hello for Business supports up to 10 users per device

question: In combined MFA and SSPR registration, which methods are users shown by default?
answer: The Microsoft Authenticator app and phone.
evidence: The user is shown Microsoft Authenticator app and phone by default

question: What happens to Conditional Access policies if Entra ID has an outage?
answer: The Backup Authentication Service takes over; resilience defaults are enabled for all policies by default, but it can't evaluate all conditions in real time.
evidence: By default, resilience defaults are enabled for all policies

question: If I create a Conditional Access policy from a template, is it enforced right away?
answer: No, by default each policy created from a template is in report-only mode.
evidence: each policy is created in report-only mode

question: How many authentication contexts can we define for Conditional Access?
answer: Up to 99 authentication context definitions (c1–c99).
evidence: up to 99 authentication context definitions

question: What's the character limit for a filter for devices rule?
answer: 3072 characters.
evidence: The maximum length for the filter rule is 3072 characters

question: In a brand-new tenant, which methods are turned on in the Authentication methods policy?
answer: None: a new tenant has all methods Off by default.
evidence: A new tenant has all methods Off by default

question: Does SSPR password writeback work while staged rollout is enabled?
answer: SSPR with writeback to on-premises isn't supported when staged rollout is enabled for a security group; it can't be guaranteed to work consistently.
evidence: isn't supported when staged rollout is enabled

question: Can users see the custom security attributes on their own profile?
answer: No, users can't view custom security attributes assigned to their own profile or to other users.
evidence: Users can't view the custom security attributes assigned to their own profile

question: A user restored Authenticator from a backup on a new phone and their work account says 'Sign in to add your account'. Is something wrong?
answer: No, that's expected: only the account name is restored for work or school accounts, so the user has to open the account and sign in again to finish setup.
evidence: Only the account name is restored

question: Account recovery can't match a user against the identity verification provider. What should I check on the user object?
answer: That the First Name and Last Name properties aren't blank; if either is blank, account recovery can't match the provider's claims.
evidence: If the First Name or Last Name properties are blank

question: Do users get the app name and location in their MFA prompt when signing in through the NPS extension?
answer: No, additional context isn't supported for the NPS extension or AD FS.
evidence: Additional context isn't supported for Network Policy Server

question: Can an admin look up a user's answers to their password reset security questions?
answer: No, administrators can't see, set, or modify another user's security questions and answers.
evidence: Administrators can't see, set, or modify the contents of another user's questions and answers

question: Without any Conditional Access policy, do users need MFA to register a passkey?
answer: Yes, MFA is still required by default to register passwordless credentials, whether or not a Conditional Access policy is configured.
evidence: MFA is still required by default to register passwordless credentials

question: Why can't I delete one of our named locations?
answer: Locations marked as trusted can't be deleted until the trusted designation is removed.
evidence: Locations marked as trusted can't be deleted without first removing the trusted designation

question: Can admins add security questions as a password reset method for themselves?
answer: No, administrator accounts can't use security questions as a verification method for SSPR.
evidence: Administrator accounts can't use security questions as verification method with SSPR
